reasoning.en: Long CVX on the Middle East supply shock — Strait of Hormuz (20% of world oil) re-escalating, Brent ~$108 (+15%). Energy is the one asset RISING on the very crisis that's crashing semis/tech (QQQ -8.6%), so it's a genuine hedge and diversifier, not correlated with the sell-off. 3-day change is only -1.5% (round-tripped Monday's ceasefire crash), so it's not multi-day-extended despite today's pop. HONEST risk: entering after a ~+14% intraday move on a fragile geopolitical catalyst that reversed violently just Monday — so ONE small slice, tight 2.5% stop, and the regime guard (SPY < -2%) is the backstop that keeps us flat if this turns into a full risk-off cascade.
